AN ACT TO AMEND THE CONSTITUTION OF THE DEMOCRATIC
SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA
Be it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-

1.
(1)  This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Nineteenth
Amendment to the Constitution.
(2) The provisions of this Act other than the provisions of
section 9 (in so far it relates to paragraph (1) of Article 46 of
the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri
Lanka)  and  the  provisions  of  section  15  shall  come  into
force on the  date on which this Act comes into operation.
(3)  The  provisions  of  section  9  (in  so  far  it  relates  to
paragraph  (1)  of  Article  46  of  the  Constitution  of  the
Democratic  Socialist  Republic  of  Sri  Lanka)  and  the
provisions of sections15, 28, 29 30 and 31 shall come into
force  upon  the  conclusion  of  the  General  Election  held
immediately  after  the  date  on  which  this  Act  comes  into
operation.
